text: {"components": [{"type": "claim", "quote": "This position is not held by one individual, but rather by the whole of the Federal Council", "gist": "The position is held collectively by the Federal Council, not by one person"}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "Federal Council", "gist": "The governing body holding the position"}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "The president is 'primus inter pares' – first among equals", "gist": "The president has no superior authority over other council members"}, {"type": "obligation", "quote": "He or she chairs the Federal Council meetings and mediates in the case of disputes", "gist": "President is required to chair meetings and mediate disputes"}, {"type": "obligation", "quote": "In urgent situations the president can order precautionary measures", "gist": "President may order precautionary measures in urgent situations"}, {"type": "obligation", "quote": "In the unlikely event that the Federal Council is unable to hold either an ordinary or an extraordinary meeting, the president may take a unilateral decision", "gist": "President can make a unilateral decision if the council cannot meet"}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "Vice Presidency", "gist": "A role mentioned in the text"}]}
